theorems.name: Submission.dph_lpfex_tendsto_of_index_maps
theorems.statement: ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ p q : ℕ → ℕ, Tendsto p atTop atTop → Tendsto q atTop atTop → Tendsto (fun i => a (q i) - a (p i)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∃ s : ℝ, Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 s)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
